entries.0bbdbe12a1fc1a09: Its revenue is centered on the domestic construction business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥259,236 million for the Construction Business (Building) and ¥74,350 million for the Construction Business (Civil Engineering), and these two businesses account for most of consolidated revenue of ¥341,181 million. Real estate and other businesses are still small at ¥7,593 million, and the company positions real estate and international businesses as “strategic businesses” to be grown.
entries.0fe30434b2d40f3e: Under its long-term management plan, “To zero, from zero.,” it is securing profit by deepening its core businesses and growing its strategic businesses, among other measures. Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,390 million.
entries.1fcf5a90a717d9f1: This business carries out civil engineering work and related businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥74,350 million. It undertakes infrastructure construction for railways, roads, tunnels, and water and sewerage systems. Subsidiaries in Indonesia and Myanmar also carry out civil engineering work.
entries.250e947638738bd9: This business carries out civil engineering work and related businesses.
entries.25950ab9293d57e5: Revenue from completed construction under construction contracts
entries.314c5d85a19b12ea: The company consists of itself, 11 subsidiaries, and five affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). Consolidated workforce is 2,911 employees (fiscal year ended March 2026). As a member of the Tokyu Group, it is responsible for the development and construction field.
entries.4c04cd637a80beaa: Government agencies, private companies, and customers of the Tokyu Group
entries.70de532eecf8eb22: Construction contracting and real estate business
entries.7188cabf88ec9868: It is advancing the long-term management plan “To zero, from zero.” (fiscal 2021 to fiscal 2030), aimed at achieving its 2030 corporate vision, “VISION2030.” It positions its domestic civil engineering, building, and building renovation businesses as “core businesses” and its international, real estate, and new businesses as “strategic businesses,” and states that it will execute five priority strategies centered on three value propositions (“decarbonization,” “zero waste,” and “disaster prevention and mitigation”), with people and digital technology as sources of competitive advantage.
entries.72c24ed67c295523: It earns contract fees by completing construction work, and also earns income from leasing and selling real estate. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥341,181 million, up 16.4% from ¥293,139 million in the prior year. The largest business is the Construction Business (Building).
entries.7e238023ba2351a1: This is a business model centered on the construction business, which undertakes building and civil engineering work for government agencies and private companies, and also includes real estate sales and leasing.
entries.89e1a8b55ce1c9a7: National and local governments and other public agencies
entries.8e79886d5cb52fc3: It mainly operates a construction business that undertakes and carries out building and civil engineering work, and also sells and leases real estate. Overseas, subsidiaries in Indonesia, Myanmar, Singapore and others carry out construction work.
entries.9483b75004b467a6: This business sells and leases real estate. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,593 million. Subsidiaries also carry out ICT-related services, a PFI business that rebuilds fire academy facilities, and investment in venture companies.
entries.b59b6932cf47c768: This is the largest business in the group, carrying out building construction and related businesses.
entries.c89431ddb57cd7e5: As a member of the Tokyu Group, it takes on the construction business field, and while collaborating with Tokyu Group companies, it treats the value of the Tokyu brand as one of its competitive strengths. At the same time, it positions people and digital technology as sources of competitive advantage.
entries.ce0920da7eb4e132: Construction clients are government agencies and private companies. It also continuously receives part of its construction orders from Tokyu Group companies, including TOKYU CORPORATION and Tokyu Dentetsu. The customer that accounted for 10% or more of revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was Kakoimachi Higashi District Urban Redevelopment Association, with revenue of ¥35,718 million.
entries.e04b86470b04a76d: This business sells and leases real estate.
entries.e128f89ed26f9cb1: Segment information prints revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (Construction Business (Building) ¥259,236 million, Construction Business (Civil Engineering) ¥74,350 million, Real Estate and Other Businesses ¥7,593 million, and consolidated revenue ¥341,181 million), and the [Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed, etc.] section includes a statement positioning international, real estate, and new businesses as “strategic businesses.”
entries.e3808d3c0373cda8: This is the largest business in the group, carrying out building construction and related businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥259,236 million. It undertakes construction work for offices, logistics facilities, housing, hotels and redevelopment projects in Japan. Overseas subsidiaries in Indonesia, Myanmar and Singapore also carry out building construction work.
entries.e567025371c067b2: Revenue from completing construction work and from the real estate business
entries.f5e2567fc3760e6a: Rental income and sales income from real estate.
entries.f65fc1080ead61a7: A general construction company of the Tokyu Group, mainly engaged in building and civil engineering work, and also in a real estate business and other businesses.
